$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor validation and autocomplete.

sources.description: Project search/index sources. Code defaults on; other project sources default off. Settings is global.

revision.description: Search-only generation nonce managed by source selection writers.

color.description: Project identity color in hexadecimal notation; omit to use the automatic color.

icon.description: Project-relative path to the canonical project logo; omit to use initials.

path.description: Project-relative Wiki folder. Parent traversal, absolute paths, Git metadata and disposable harness storage are not allowed. Defaults to wiki/.

index.description: Markdown home page relative to the Wiki folder. Nested paths are supported; parent traversal and absolute paths are not allowed. Defaults to index.md.

wiki.description: Project Wiki documents and assets. Omitted settings use wiki/index.md.

command.description: Shell command to run in the project.

recentCommandRuns.description: Last successful launch time (Unix milliseconds), keyed by launch:<command-id> or package:<script-name>. Updated automatically; not a run counter.

expandedDirectories.description: Expanded project-relative folder paths. The tree itself is not stored.

providerOrder.description: Last provider quota-family popularity order, restored before loading usage. Unknown ids are retained for compatibility.

collapsedSections.description: Collapsed usage section ids: provider-limits, overview, activity, daily, models, sessions, cache. Unknown ids are retained for compatibility.

title: Pix Project Workspace
description: Project identity, Wiki, launch commands and Desktop view state in .pi/workspace.jsonc. Unknown fields are preserved.
